resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (or other open-source plane-wave DFT code)

access.notes: The agent may use any open-source plane-wave DFT code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, ABINIT) with GGA exchange-correlation.

resources.name: SSSP pseudopotential library (efficiency set) or equivalent

access.notes: GGA pseudopotentials are needed for Sc, Al, Ga, In, Tl, and C.

resources.name: Standard elemental crystal structures (Sc hcp, C graphite, A elements in their standard structures, ScC rocksalt)

access.notes: Atomic positions and lattice parameters can be obtained from crystallographic databases (e.g., ICSD, American Mineralogist Crystal Structure Database).
